# Obot AI

> > Obot AI provides enterprise-grade MCP (Model Context Protocol) Gateway solutions for AI agent development, authentication, and access control.

Formerly Acorn Labs, Obot AI specializes in Model Context Protocol infrastructure with products including Obot MCP Gateway and Nanobot framework. The platform helps enterprises integrate MCP servers with AI agents while maintaining security, compliance, and governance controls across OpenAI, Anthropic, and other LLM providers.

## Key Topics

- Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- Obot MCP Gateway
- MCP Servers and Clients
- Enterprise AI Security and Access Control
- OAuth 2.1 Authentication
- MCP Catalogs and Ecosystem
- Nanobot Framework
- AI Agent Development
- Enterprise Compliance and Governance
- OpenAI and Anthropic Integration
- MCP Tools Landscape
- Azure OpenAI Support
- Docker Deployment
- Python and GitHub Integration

## MCP Gateway and Enterprise Solutions

- [Managing Access Control for MCP Servers in the Enterprise](https://obot.ai/blog/managing-access-control-for-mcp-servers-in-the-enterprise): Enterprise access control for MCP servers with Obot MCP Gateway
- [Evaluating Enterprise MCP Gateways](https://obot.ai/blog/evaluating-enterprise-mcp-gateways): Enterprise MCP gateway evaluation: Obot vs Microsoft vs IBM comparison
- [Obot MCP Gateway v0.16.0: Enhancing Enterprise Control](https://obot.ai/blog/announcing-obot-mcp-platform-v0-16-0-api-keys-model-access-policies-and-other-enterprise-ready-controls): v0.16.0 release: API keys, model policies & Azure OpenAI support
- [Single MCP Gateway vs Multiple MCP Servers](https://obot.ai/blog/single-mcp-gateway-vs-multiple-mcp-servers): Architecture comparison: MCP gateway vs multiple server deployment
- [Refactoring Our MCP Gateway: From Intercepting Server to Composable Infrastructure](https://obot.ai/blog/refactoring-our-mcp-gateway-from-intercepting-server-to-composable-infrastructure): Technical deep-dive: Obot MCP Gateway architecture refactoring
